title: Build Your AI Follow-up Assistant
artifact: A reusable assistant that turns rough notes into a recap, action list, and follow-up draft
description: Turn messy notes from a meeting, customer enquiry, or supplier call into a clear recap, next steps, and a message you can review and send. Build and save your own AI follow-up assistant in one hands-on, offline session. No coding.
mission: An offline space for non-techies to put AI to work, one real use-case project at a time.
bringLabel: A laptop and charger are recommended for setting up your assistant. Bring a phone, a signed-in personal Google account, and one non-confidential example of rough work notes. Sample notes are available if you prefer.
outcomes: Your own follow-up assistant, saved as a Gemini Gem or reusable instructions
One reviewed recap, action list, and email or WhatsApp draft from your notes
A second test with different notes, so you know how to reuse it
A fact-check and privacy checklist to use before sending anything

agenda.title: See one conversation become a follow-up
agenda.body: Watch the host turn sample notes into a recap, action list, and message. Compare the draft with the notes and spot an unsupported assumption.

agenda.title: Choose your real work example
agenda.body: Use meeting notes, a customer enquiry, or a supplier conversation. Remove names and confidential details. Set the recipient, language, tone, and desired next step.

agenda.title: Build your assistant
agenda.body: Follow along in Gemini on the web. Add your instructions, draft the first follow-up, and refine it with help from the hosts. Save a Gem, or keep the instructions in a document if your account cannot create one.

agenda.title: Take a break
agenda.body: Compare notes with someone at your table. Ask for help with anything that is still unclear.

agenda.title: Check it, then try again
agenda.body: Verify names, amounts, deadlines, and who owns each task. Run a different example. Make sure the assistant asks when information is missing instead of inventing it.

agenda.title: Save it for your next working day
agenda.body: Save your assistant and reviewed output. Do one final run yourself, share optionally, and leave with a simple checklist for using it again at work.

faqs.q: Do I need any technical experience?
faqs.a: No coding, automation tools, or AI experience is required. If you can type a message and use a web browser, you can take part. We build step by step in the room.

faqs.q: Is this useful if I do not run a business?
faqs.a: Yes. Professionals can use meeting or project notes; business owners can use customer or supplier conversations; consultants can use client calls. Everyone builds the same notes-to-follow-up assistant with their own context.

faqs.q: What exactly will I build on 27 September?
faqs.a: A reusable follow-up assistant, one reviewed recap with an action list and message draft, and a second test on new notes. You save it as a Gemini Gem or reusable instructions. This is one practical project, not a tour of AI tools.

faqs.q: How is this different from asking ChatGPT to write an email?
faqs.a: You set up reusable instructions for your work, tone, and output format. You teach the assistant to separate facts from missing information, test it on two examples, and learn how to check the result. The goal is repeatable work, not one impressive answer.

faqs.q: Do I need a paid AI subscription?
faqs.a: The session is designed around a free personal Google account and Gemini on the web. Features and usage limits can vary. If Gem creation is unavailable on your account, the same instructions work in a normal chat and can be saved in a document. No paid upgrade is required for the core exercise.

faqs.q: Can I attend with only a phone?
faqs.a: A laptop is recommended for creating and testing your Gem in a browser. A phone can be used for the chat-and-saved-instructions version. Sign in to your Google account before you arrive and bring your charger.

faqs.q: Will it send WhatsApp messages or emails automatically?
faqs.a: No. It creates drafts from notes you provide. It does not connect to your inbox, record calls, send messages, or chase people in the background. You check, edit, and send each message yourself.

faqs.q: Can I use confidential client or company information?
faqs.a: Please do not bring private client, employee, patient, financial, or company data. Use anonymised notes you have permission to share, or our fictional samples. Follow your employer’s AI policy. Never record someone without their permission.

faqs.q: Do I need to have attended the June workshop?
faqs.a: No. Each workshop stands on its own. Our first session in June 2026 was about building and hosting websites. September is a different project and starts from the basics.

faqs.q: Where is it, and what does the ticket include?
faqs.a: The workshop is offline in Salt Lake, Kolkata, on Sunday 27 September 2026, 11:00 AM–2:00 PM. The ticket is ₹799 for the three-hour guided session and reusable instructions. There are 50 seats. The exact venue is shared after reservation; contact us before booking if you need to check travel or accessibility.
